metadata.description: Skills for people who use AI a couple of times a week and do not live in a terminal. The general marketplace, and the one taught in the workshops.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Runs once. Gets you from "I installed this" to "it knows who I am, and something runs tomorrow morning without me." Finds what it can, asks only what it cannot, shows you the whole suggestion, and writes the files every other skill reads. Its check skill tells you at any time which skills can run and which are blocked by which file.

plugins.name: writing
plugins.description: Four skills for work that already exists: put your voice back into generated text, catch the habits that mean nobody edited it, read a draft as the specific person who will push back, and reorder an answer so the reader knows what to do. Nothing here writes from scratch, sends, or publishes.

plugins.name: growth
plugins.description: The one that judges how you worked, not what you produced. Compares your week against the priorities you confirmed, ranks what is in front of you against them, keeps a running record of what actually went well in your own words, and gives feedback against a standard you set. Every output is a comparison with its evidence and its window named; nothing here writes except the wins record, and only with your yes.
